# truenas_vm_clone (Action)

Clones a VM (vm.clone), copying its configuration and zvol disks into a new VM.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (Number) ID of the VM to clone (truenas_vm.<name>.id).

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name for the cloned VM. If omitted, TrueNAS derives one from the source.
